_comment: What node bin/install.js permissions adds to your user settings (<claude home>/settings.json), next to the walkaway hooks. deny binds in every mode, bypass included. ask prompts even in bypass mode, so it is kept to the few acts a person should always see happen; it must stay a subset of what walkaway/walkaway_permission_hook.py refuses (walkaway/selftest_hooks.py checks the hook side). Off-limits folders from workspace.config.json privacy.never_read become Read/Edit/Write deny rules too.
